title: I Hatched an Army to Stop the Moon.
summary: With four days until the moon hits, a kid hatches a Blue Fire Knight and a Storm Giant from the egg everyone mocked. The sword scratches the moon, and the town must choose how to reach it.
frame_0: The orange-scarved kid stands on a clay rooftop between the Blue Fire Knight and the Storm Giant. A burning moon trails fire high above them, behind bands of cirrus. The title and 4 DAYS countdown appear on frame zero.
package_differences: Jake requested edited coverage throughout the story. The former 46-second glide is replaced by cuts on the spoken beats.
A physical orbital set shows the home planet, the hurricane dissipating, the sword scratching the burning moon, and the imagined storm staircase. The town sees the moon far above the roofline.
camera: Steady cut shots on the dialogue, with short, slow dollies for reveals and shallow focus on faces. Separate tripod views in the square and in orbit.
creature_handoff: Model Builder replacement proof 0cdcc1fa. Both new native character collections appear in the full film, rooftop, vote, posting thumbnail and sponsor preview.
audio: Locked voices. Original effects and CC0 location recordings. Effects fall silent in the square and when the moon stops.
